sources: https://resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/book/3622B111-5368-4253-B4AA-A5A455600AFA (ResNexus booking page linked as 'Reserve Campsites', loaded in a headless browser 2026-10-27)

values.note: 2026 general-public rates: RV site $25 a day or $150 a week; tent site $18 ($108 weekly). Southern Ute tribal members pay less with a SUIT ID. Day use is $5 per car per day for non-members (the page does not say whether campers pay it). A daily lake fishing permit ($10 adult) is needed only to fish.

fees.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/ and https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('Campground Rates ... General Public ... RV Sites $25 [daily] $150 [weekly]'; 'Non-Tribal Member fee per car is $5.00 a day'; 'You must purchase a daily Lake fishing permit to fish at Lake Capote'), read 2026-10-27. The ResNexus engine quotes the tent sites at $18.00/night but showed no RV site for the only open dates (after the 2026 season closed), so no in-season engine quote was possible.

hookups.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('10 RV sites with 30-amp & 20-amp electric connections, potable water connection, fire-ring, and picnic table'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 10 RV sites and 30 tent sites; two vehicles and eight people per site.

sites.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('10 RV sites ...', '30 tent sites with fire ring and picnic table', 'Only 2 vehicles are allowed per site', 'Only 8 people per site'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Bathhouse with toilets, sinks and showers; dump station on the road west of the bathhouse. The bait shop sells food, snacks, drinks and fishing supplies and has a fish-cleaning station and an emergency phone (limited cell reception).

facilities.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('Dump station for grey/black water is located on road west of bathhouse', 'Bathhouse including public toilets, sinks, and showers') + https://www.lakecapote.com/bait-shop/ ('Food, Snacks & Drinks', 'Fishing Supplies', 'Emergency Public Phone (there is limited cell reception at Lake Capote)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 schedule: March 5-29 open Thursday to Sunday only (campers stay Thursday to Saturday nights and leave by Sunday afternoon); March 30 - October 27 open daily; closed for the season October 28. No water in the campground in March or October.

season.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/ ('2026 Operating Schedule: March 5 - March 29 Open Thursday through Sunday ... March 30 - October 27 Open 7 Days a week; October 28 Closed for the season'; 'campers and RVs are welcome to stay overnight Thursday through Saturday nights but must depart by Sunday afternoon') + https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('no water in the campground for March or October'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Book online on the operator's ResNexus page by the day before arrival; same day, call 970-883-2273 or ask at the bait shop (8 a.m.-6 p.m.). After hours an open site has a permit on the board outside the store and can be self-registered, for one night only. All visitors check in at the bait shop. Cancel 3+ days ahead for a 90% refund.

booking.source: https://www.lakecapote.com/campground/ ('Online reservation must be made the day before you would like to camp ... you may call us at 1-970-883-2273. Or feel free to stop by the bait shop'; 'check the reservation board outside of the store & if a camping permit is in the sign board - site is available'; 'Walk-in is only good for ONE NIGHT'; 'Maximum stay is 18 days'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-27

note: Southern Ute Indian Tribe recreation area on CO-151 south of Pagosa Springs, run by the tribe's Division of Wildlife around a stocked fishing lake; no Colorado fishing license needed, but a daily lake permit is. Tribal rangers patrol; no alcohol or firearms. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026) + ResNexus page: confirmed RV $25/night (2026, general public), 30-amp electric with water, dump, camp store (bait shop), reservable online. Season year_round false -> March 5 - October 27 (2026). Added 40 sites (10 RV, 30 tent), showers, ResNexus url, fcfs after_cutoff (walk-ins one night), 18-night max. Note trimmed of rates/hookups/RV Life. Not stated: max rig length, sewer.
flags: Price/presence: passes. 2026 posted RV rate $25 (general public), own website with phone 970-883-2273 (matches the entry), ResNexus booking engine, Google 4.5 over 63 reviews (co_private verdict 2026-10-02). No in-season engine quote was possible: the 2026 season ended Oct 27 and ResNexus showed only the tent sites ($18.00) for the open dates.

Ownership: the site describes it as the Southern Ute Indian Tribe's recreation area, managed by the tribe's Division of Wildlife (mission 'for the benefit of Southern Ute Tribal members ... and other Lake visitors'), i.e. tribal-government run rather than a private business. Stored 'private' follows the database's convention for tribal parks (no tribal class); a human may prefer 'local'.
Status: closed for the season from October 28, 2026 (ordinary end of season).
Day-use fee: $5 per car per day for non-tribal visitors; the page does not say whether campers pay it on top of the $25 (it would still be under $50).
